steps.title: Prepare the tools
steps.instruction: Prepare a small pot, measuring cup, hand blender, and narrow blender cup.

steps.title: Combine the base
steps.instruction: Add egg yolk, water, lemon juice, and salt to the blender cup.

steps.title: Heat the butter
steps.instruction: Melt the butter until it bubbles and reaches 220 degrees Fahrenheit.

steps.title: Blend the sauce
steps.instruction: Run the hand blender and slowly add the hot butter.

steps.title: Serve or hold the sauce
steps.instruction: Serve the sauce immediately or keep it covered in a warm place.
